cards.title: Treatment Coordinator
cards.subtitle: Responsible for your care pathway
cards.body:
Your treatment coordinator is responsible for your treatment agreement and your care pathway.

Upon admission, you will have a conversation with the psychiatrist about your wishes.

cards.title: Lead Clinician
cards.subtitle: Final medical responsibility
cards.body: Your lead clinician may be the psychiatrist or nurse specialist. They have final medical responsibility for your treatment.

cards.title: General Practitioner
cards.subtitle: Medical consultations on site
cards.body: It is possible to consult the general practitioner connected to the clinic at IVB High Care.

cards.title: Social Work
cards.subtitle: Practical support
cards.body: The social workers at IVB High Care are available for questions about benefits and other practical matters.

cards.title: Peer Support Worker
cards.subtitle: Peer contact & conversation
cards.body: Our team includes a peer support worker. You can speak with him about your treatment from a shared perspective.

cards.title: Spiritual Care Provider
cards.subtitle: Meaning and life questions
cards.body: The spiritual care provider offers support with meaning, life questions, worldview and spirituality.

cards.title: Personal Support Workers
cards.subtitle: 4 fixed points of contact
cards.body: The permanent team consists of nurses, social care workers, security staff and peer support workers.

cards.title: Support Network
cards.subtitle: Involving family and loved ones
cards.body: With your consent, your support network will be closely involved in your treatment to contribute to your recovery.

cards.title: Consultation Meetings
cards.subtitle: Care Coordination Meeting and Daily Meeting
cards.body:
ZAG — Care Coordination Meeting
During your admission, you will regularly have a ZAG.

cards.title: Sports Coach
cards.subtitle: Subtitle
cards.body: You can also do one-to-one exercise.
